sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐秘世界。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: When it comes to sports, the uniforms matter a lot.
sentences.zh: 说到体育运动，队服至关重要。

sentences.en: Jerry Seinfeld famously said,
sentences.zh: 杰瑞·宋飞曾有一句名言：

sentences.en: Although team loyalty is a kind of hard thing to justify in the end.
sentences.zh: 虽然说到底，对球队的忠诚很难找到充分的理由。

sentences.en: You know, I love the Giants, but when you think about it, who are the Giants?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我热爱巨人队，但仔细想想，巨人队究竟是谁？

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it's different guys.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是不同的人。

sentences.en: Every year it's different guys, right?
sentences.zh: 每年都是不同的人，对吧？

sentences.en: Teams will move from city to city.
sentences.zh: 球队会从一个城市搬到另一个城市。

sentences.en: The players come and go, they get traded, they retire, they leave via free agency.
sentences.zh: 球员来来往往，他们被交易、退役、通过自由球员身份离开。

sentences.en: But you keep rooting for those colors and that logo and that uniform.
sentences.zh: 但你依然支持着那些颜色、那个队徽还有那套队服。

sentences.en: You're rooting for clothes when you get right down to it.
sentences.zh: 仔细想想，你支持的其实是衣服。

sentences.en: It's the same outfits.
sentences.zh: 都是一样的行头。

sentences.en: I'm rooting for an outfit.
sentences.zh: 我支持的是一套行头。

sentences.en: That's what it's come down to.
sentences.zh: 事情最终就变成了这样。

sentences.en: I want my team's clothes to beat the clothes from the city.
sentences.zh: 我希望我支持的球队的衣服能击败对手城市的衣服。

sentences.en: That's not so bad either.
sentences.zh: 这其实也没那么糟。

sentences.en: There's nothing really wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 这也没什么真正不对的地方。

sentences.en: It's laundry.
sentences.zh: 这就是洗衣服。

sentences.en: We're rooting for screaming about laundry here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里为之大喊大叫的其实是洗衣物。

sentences.en: And the measure of this, according to Paul Lucas, the creator of UniWatch,
sentences.zh: 根据“球衣观察”（UniWatch）网站创始人保罗·卢卡的说法，

sentences.en: a website devoted to the obsessive study of athletics aesthetics, is this.
sentences.zh: 这是一个致力于狂热研究田径审美的网站，其衡量标准就是这个。

sentences.en: I'm a passionate New York Mets fan, and I really, really hate the New York Yankees.
sentences.zh: 我是纽约大都会队的死忠粉，我真的、真的很讨厌纽约洋基队。

sentences.en: But if the entire Mets team, 25 guys, is traded even up for the entire Yankees team, 25 guys,
sentences.zh: 但如果大都会队全队25名球员，今天被原封不动地整体交易给洋基队的25名球员，

sentences.en: today, who do I root for tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天我该支持谁？

sentences.en: And to me, the answer is obvious.
sentences.zh: 对吉我来说，答案显而易见。

sentences.en: It's a no-brainer.
sentences.zh: 这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: I root for whoever is wearing the Mets uniform, no matter who it is,
sentences.zh: 我支持穿着大都会队队服的人，不管他是谁，

sentences.en: even if it's a bunch of guys who were wearing the Yankees uniform the day before.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是一群前一天还穿着洋基队队服的人。

sentences.en: So the identities of the players are almost irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 所以球员的身份几乎是无关紧要的。

sentences.en: What we root for is the uniform.
sentences.zh: 我们支持的是队服。

sentences.en: And that is an unusually strong form of brand loyalty.
sentences.zh: 这是一种异常强烈的品牌忠诚度。

sentences.en: Because if I like, say, a certain brand of cereal, let's say I like Cheerios,
sentences.zh: 因为如果我喜欢，比方说某种麦片品牌，假设我喜欢脆谷乐（Cheerios），

sentences.en: well, I identify with the box and the logo and the colors and all that, the package design.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我对盒子、标志、颜色以及所有这些包装设计产生认同感。

sentences.en: But I also, presumably, like the product.
sentences.zh: 但我想，我也同样喜欢这个产品。

sentences.en: And if I find that the quality of the product has changed,
sentences.zh: 如果我发现产品的质量变了，

sentences.en: you know, if it doesn't taste good anymore, or if some aspect of it,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果它不好吃了，或者它的某一方面，

sentences.en: if it doesn't stay crunchy in milk or whatever,
sentences.zh: 如果它在牛奶里泡不脆了之类的，

sentences.en: I may give it one or two more tries based on my brand loyalty,
sentences.zh: 基于我对品牌的忠诚，我可能会再给它一两次机会，

sentences.en: but eventually I will leave that brand.
sentences.zh: 但最终我会离开这个品牌。

sentences.en: I will abandon it if I find that the quality is no longer there.
sentences.zh: 如果我发现质量已经不复存在，我会抛弃它。

sentences.en: But in sports, the content of the product and the quality of that content,
sentences.zh: 但在体育界，产品的内容和该内容的质量，

sentences.en: meaning the players, is changing all the time.
sentences.zh: 也就是指球员，在不断变化。

sentences.en: You can be really good one year, really bad the next year.
sentences.zh: 你可能今年表现极佳，明年就一落千丈。

sentences.en: Your roster can turn over.
sentences.zh: 你的球员名单会大换血。

sentences.en: So the content of the product is constantly in flux.
sentences.zh: 所以产品的内容一直在变动。

sentences.en: But we stay loyal to whoever is wearing that uniform.
sentences.zh: 但我们始终忠于穿着那套队服的任何人。

sentences.en: And that is an unusually, to my mind, it's a unique form of brand loyalty.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是一种异常的、独特的品牌忠诚度。

sentences.en: There's nothing else like it in our consumer landscape.
sentences.zh: 在我们的消费世界里，没有其他东西能与之相比。

sentences.en: Like Paul Lucas, my friend Jesse Thorne also obsesses over baseball uniforms,
sentences.zh: 和保罗·卢卡一样，我的朋友杰西·索恩也对棒球服痴迷不已，

sentences.en: although he didn't make a career of it.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有以此为生。

sentences.en: He has another job.
sentences.zh: 他有别的工作。

sentences.en: I'm Jesse Thorne.
sentences.zh: 我是杰西·索恩。

sentences.en: I'm the owner of MaximumFun.org and the host of the NPR show Bullseye.
sentences.zh: 我是 MaximumFun.org 的老板，也是 NPR 节目《靶心》（Bullseye）的主持人。

sentences.en: There are certain things about a uniform that serve a purpose by being uniform.
sentences.zh: 队服的某些特征通过保持统一发挥着特定作用。

sentences.en: They help the players identify each other.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助球员互相识别。

sentences.en: They help us rally behind our team.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助我们团结在我们的队伍身后。

sentences.en: They give us something cool to buy.
sentences.zh: 它们为我们提供了很酷的购买选择。

sentences.en: But there are certain things on a uniform that aren't uniform.
sentences.zh: 但队服上也有某些并不统一的地方。

sentences.en: Things that a player can choose.
sentences.zh: 球员可以自行选择的事物。

sentences.en: And the number of things that a player can choose are very, very small.
sentences.zh: 而球员可以选择的东西数量非常、非常少。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a big controversy when I was a kid,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我还是个孩子的时候，曾引发过一场巨大的争议，

sentences.en: when Ken Griffey Jr.
sentences.zh: 当时小肯·格里菲

sentences.en: shagged balls in the outfield during batting practice
sentences.zh: 在击球练习时在场外接球，

sentences.en: with his baseball hat on backwards.
sentences.zh: 头戴反向的棒球帽。

sentences.en: It's a big controversy now when a baseball player wears his cap brim totally flat
sentences.zh: 如今，当棒球运动员将帽檐戴得笔平，

sentences.en: in what you might call the hip-hop style.
sentences.zh: 也就是你所谓的嘻哈风格时，这也会引发巨大的争议。

sentences.en: As opposed to curved, kind of?
sentences.zh: 而不是微微弯曲的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, is that what you mean?
sentences.zh: 就像，你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I mean, they literally make a device that you can buy at the sporting goods store
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，市面上确实有卖这样一种小工具，你可以在体育用品商店买到

sentences.en: or order via mail order that will give you, quote-unquote,
sentences.zh: 或者通过邮购订购，它能给你带来，所谓的

sentences.en: the perfect curve to your brim.
sentences.zh: 完美的帽檐弧度。

sentences.en: And I, I mean, I remember as a little leaguer obsessing over getting the brim of my hat
sentences.zh: 而且我，我的意思是，我记得自己小时候曾痴迷于把帽檐

sentences.en: to curve exactly right.
sentences.zh: 弄出恰到好处的弧度。

sentences.en: And I was not the only one.
sentences.zh: 我并不是唯一一个这样的人。

sentences.en: We had Jesse Thorne talk with Paul Lucas of UniWatch,
sentences.zh: 我们请杰西·索恩与“球衣观察”的保罗·卢卡进行了交谈，

sentences.en: and he discovered that Paul also zeroes in on the subtle expressions of individuality
sentences.zh: 他发现保罗也非常关注棒球运动员队服上对个性的微妙表达。

sentences.en: on a baseball player's uniform.
sentences.zh: 我总是非常警惕任何能瞥见球员帽檐下方的机会，

sentences.en: I'm always very alert for any glimpse of the underside of a player's cap brim,
sentences.zh: 因为多年来，这个部位的颜色——它被称为帽檐下侧或遮阳帽下沿——

sentences.en: because over the years, the color of that element, it's called the underbrim or the underviser,
sentences.zh: 已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: has changed.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，它们是绿色的，后来对大多数球队来说变成了灰色，

sentences.en: When I was a kid, they were green, then they changed to gray for most teams,
sentences.zh: 而现在它们大多是黑色的，有些球员会在帽檐下侧写点东西。

sentences.en: and now they are mostly black, and some players will write something on the underbrim.
sentences.zh: 现在黑色的帽檐变多了，这么做的球员反而少了，

sentences.en: Fewer players do it now, now that they're black,
sentences.zh: 因为你必须使用白色或银色的记号笔。

sentences.en: because you have to use, like, a white or a silver Sharpie.
sentences.zh: 早在它们是灰色的时候，球员随便拿支旧笔就能写。

sentences.en: Back when they were gray, players could just use any old pen.
sentences.zh: 球员们会在那里写一些不寻常的东西，

sentences.en: And players would write unusual things there,
sentences.zh: 比如鼓舞人心的寄语、他们孩子的名字，或是其他诸如此类的内容。

sentences.en: inspirational messages or the names of their children or whatever the case might be.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这始终是队服世界里一种有趣的隐藏区域

sentences.en: And that always, to me, was an interesting sort of stealth area of the uniform world
sentences.zh: 或者说宇宙，就像我喜欢称呼的那样。

sentences.en: or the universe, as I like to call it.
sentences.zh: 但另一件让我有点...

sentences.en: But the other thing I'm kind of...
sentences.zh: 你很喜欢这个，对吧？

sentences.en: You like that, huh?
sentences.zh: 这个宇宙中存在连续性吗？

sentences.en: Is there continuity in the universe?
sentences.zh: 但是当保罗和杰西这两个棒球服狂热爱好者聚在一起交谈时，

sentences.en: But when you get two baseball uniform aficionados like Paul and Jesse together in conversation,
sentences.zh: 棒球服中有一个领域是他们真正为之疯狂的，

sentences.en: there is one area of the baseball uniform that they truly geek out about,
sentences.zh: 那就是裤腿与球袜的交界处。

sentences.en: the intersection between the pant leg and the sock.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是膝盖以下的所有区域。

sentences.en: Basically, the whole area below the knee.
sentences.zh: 这是队服中最不受规范、最少受监管、也确实最不统一的部分。

sentences.en: And it's the least legislated, least regulated, and really least uniform part of the uniform.
sentences.zh: 尽管棒球球队历史上一直以球袜的颜色来命名，

sentences.en: Even though baseball teams have been historically named after the color of their socks,
sentences.zh: 但却没有规定裤子长度的规则，

sentences.en: there is no rule governing the length of the pants,
sentences.zh: 也没有规定你是否真的能看到那些球袜。

sentences.en: or whether or not you will actually see those socks.
sentences.zh: 而在过去的一代人时间里，情况确实发生了变化。

sentences.en: And that has really changed in the last generation.
sentences.zh: 在过去大约一个世纪左右的时间里，变化尤其巨大。

sentences.en: And it's changed a particularly lot over, you know, the last century or so.
sentences.zh: 早期的棒球服基本上穿的是马裤。

sentences.en: So early baseball uniforms had essentially knickers.
sentences.zh: 你穿马裤时会搭配什么？

sentences.en: And what do you wear with knickers?
sentences.zh: 你穿的是长筒袜。

sentences.en: You wear stockings.
sentences.zh: 这就是早期棒球服的穿着方式。

sentences.en: And that's what early baseball uniforms were.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪的过程中，这些马裤开始变得越来越长，

sentences.en: And over the course of the 20th century, those knickers started getting longer and longer,
sentences.zh: 它们的裤脚开始一点点往下垂，

sentences.en: and they started drooping a little lower and a little lower,
sentences.zh: 从盖住小腿中部到小腿下部，再往下垂一点。

sentences.en: and they went to mid-calf and then lower-calf and then a little lower.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们有那么多球员把裤子一直拉到鞋帮处，

sentences.en: And now we have so many of the players who wear their pants all the way down to their shoe tops,
sentences.zh: 就像那种带脚套的睡衣一样。

sentences.en: like footie pajamas.
sentences.zh: 然后还有少数球员，比如亚历克斯·罗德里格斯、柯蒂斯·格兰德森和铃木一朗，

sentences.en: And then you have a handful of players like, say, Alex Rodriguez and Curtis Granderson and Ishiro Suzuki
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢把裤子高高卷起。

sentences.en: who like to hike their pants up high.
sentences.zh: 所以他们属于少数派，但确实有一部分球员会这么做。

sentences.en: So they're a minority, but there is a faction of players who do that.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有统一的标准。

sentences.en: But there's no uniformity to it.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们有这些把裤子一直穿到鞋帮处的球员，真是一种遗憾甚至是一场悲剧，

sentences.en: And I think it's a shame or even a tragedy that we've got these players who wear the pants all the way down to the shoe tops
sentences.zh: 因为当你把球袜遮住时，你基本上是在玷污棒球的袜饰传统。

sentences.en: because when you cover up the socks, you're basically dishonoring baseball's hosiery heritage.
sentences.zh: 让我们来剖析一下。

sentences.en: So let's break it down.
sentences.zh: 如今的棒球裤是弹力聚酯纤维材质的。

sentences.en: Today, baseball pants are stretchy polyester.
sentences.zh: 过去它们是羊毛呢的。

sentences.en: They used to be wool flannel.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在的裤子，你可以穿得紧身一点或者宽松一点。

sentences.en: So the pants that they have now, you can wear them kind of tight or loose.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择各种不同长度来穿裤子。

sentences.en: And you can wear your pants at a variety of different lengths.
sentences.zh: 它们可以一直垂到鞋帮的顶部。

sentences.en: So they can go down all the way to the top of your shoes.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有些球员甚至会使用一根从鞋底下方穿过的带子，

sentences.en: And in fact, some players have gone so far as to have a strap that goes underneath their shoes
sentences.zh: 以此来固定裤子，不让任何球袜露出来。

sentences.en: to keep it, keep from showing any sock at all.
sentences.zh: 你可以把裤子提到小腿底部的位置，这样能露出一点球袜。

sentences.en: You can wear your pants up sort of at the bottom of your calves, which shows a little bit of sock.
sentences.zh: 这大概是大多数球员的做法。

sentences.en: That's probably what most players do.
sentences.zh: 他们就任由裤子垂在那里。

sentences.en: And they just kind of let them sit there.
sentences.zh: 你可以把裤子一直拉过小腿，提到小腿顶部，就像他们

sentences.en: You can wear your pants up all the way over your calves, at the top of your calves, like they were, you know,
sentences.zh: 穿着20世纪早期的运动裤一样，你知道的，就像马裤或是二代加长裤、四代加长裤那样。

sentences.en: sporting pants from the early part of the 20th century, you know, like they were breeks or plus twos or plus fours.
sentences.zh: 如果你以这种风格穿着裤子，裤脚一直拉到膝盖，

sentences.en: And if you wear your pants in that style with the bottoms all the way up to your knees,
sentences.zh: 你可以选择纯色的球袜。

sentences.en: You can either wear solid colored socks.
sentences.zh: 你可以穿着侧边带有条纹、旨在模仿马镫袜的球袜。

sentences.en: You can wear socks with a stripe up the side that's meant to simulate a stirrup sock.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以穿真正的马镫袜。

sentences.en: Or you can wear actual stirrup socks.
sentences.zh: 在这些选择中，对于坚定的老派球迷来说，马镫袜是棒球袜饰的极致。

sentences.en: Of these choices, stirrup socks are the ultimate in baseball hosiery for the diehard old school fans.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要想象一下马镫袜的长相，它基本上有两层袜子。

sentences.en: If you need help picturing a stirrup, there are basically two layers of sock.
sentences.zh: 底层是一双普通的旧袜子，但外面还有一层不同颜色的外袜。

sentences.en: There's a bottom layer that's a normal old sock, but there's also an exterior sock that's a different color.
sentences.zh: 但那双袜子的底部只是一根穿在球员足弓下方的带子。

sentences.en: But the bottom of that sock is just a strap that goes underneath the arch of the player's foot.
sentences.zh: 马镫的设计理念可以追溯到一个世纪前。

sentences.en: The idea behind stirrups goes back about a century.
sentences.zh: 过去的棒球裤只是马裤，你得搭配长筒袜穿。

sentences.en: Baseball pants used to be just knickers and you would wear stockings with them.
sentences.zh: 但在棒球早期，棒球是一项相当粗野激烈的运动。

sentences.en: But in the early days of baseball, baseball was a pretty rough and tumble game.
sentences.zh: 球员们经常会被鞋钉刮伤。

sentences.en: Players would often get spiked.
sentences.zh: 有些球员，比如伟大的名人堂成员泰·柯布，以故意把鞋钉磨锋利而闻名，

sentences.en: And there were some players like the great Hall of Famer Ty Cobb who would famously sharpen their spikes
sentences.zh: 这样当他们滑向二垒或三垒时，就会试图划伤内野手。

sentences.en: so that when they slid into second or third base, they would try to cut up the infielder.
sentences.zh: 如果你小腿被鞋钉刮到，你的长筒袜就会被割破。

sentences.en: And if you got spiked in the shin, you would get cut in your stockings.
sentences.zh: 而那个时代的织物染料并不十分牢固。

sentences.en: And the fabric dyes in those days were not colorfaSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你被鞋钉刮伤，长筒袜上的染料可能会进入伤口，导致你血中毒。

sentences.en: And so if you got spiked, dye from your stockings could get in the wound and you could get blood poisoning.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你被扎伤了，长筒袜上的染料可能会进到伤心里，导致你血液中毒。

sentences.en: Or so was the thinking.
sentences.zh: 至少当时大家是这么想的。

sentences.en: I don't know if there are any documented cases of players who actually got blood poisoning.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是否有任何关于球员真正得败血症的有据可查的病例。

sentences.en: And so someone got the idea, and we don't know who, some great hero who deserves a statue,
sentences.zh: 于是有人想出了这个主意，我们不知道是谁，某个应该拥有雕像的伟大英雄，

sentences.en: the statue to the great unknown stirrups innovator, that if you wore an undersock, an extra layer of sock,
sentences.zh: 为这位伟大的未知球圈创新者树立的雕像，如果你穿一双打底袜，也就是多穿一层袜子，

sentences.en: you would have an extra layer of protection, a sanitary layer of protection.
sentences.zh: 你就会多一层保护，一层卫生的保护。

sentences.en: And so this undersock became known as a sanitary or a pair of such socks became known as sanitaries or sannies.
sentences.zh: 于是这种打底袜被称为卫生袜，或者这样的一对袜子被称为卫生袜或简称为“sannies”。

sentences.en: And then the overstocking, well, they didn't want you to have to wear the stocking over the undersock
sentences.zh: 然后是外层长袜，嗯，他们不想让你把长袜套在打底袜外面

sentences.en: because now you'd be wearing two pairs of socks and your shoes wouldn't fit anymore.
sentences.zh: 因为这样你就要穿两双袜子，你的鞋子就穿不下了。

sentences.en: And so they decided to cut out the foot area of the overstocking and create this little stirrup opening.
sentences.zh: 所以他们决定剪掉外层长袜的足部区域，创造出这个小小的球圈开口。

sentences.en: And that's how baseball stirrups were born.
sentences.zh: 棒球球圈就这样诞生了。

sentences.en: And originally, that opening was tiny.
sentences.zh: 起初，那个开口非常小。

sentences.en: It was just enough for your foot to fit through.
sentences.zh: 刚好够你的脚穿过去。

sentences.en: And almost immediately, players began pulling it and stretching it higher.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，球员们就开始拉扯它，把它拉得更高。

sentences.en: And so more and more of an opening appeared.
sentences.zh: 于是开口变得越来越大。

sentences.en: And that exposed more and more of the sanitary undersock, which was usually white.
sentences.zh: 这露出了越来越多通常是白色的卫生打底袜。

sentences.en: So you started having this sort of interplay of color of the ever-widening opening of the colored stirrup and the white undersock.
sentences.zh: 所以你开始看到这种色彩的交织，也就是不断扩大的彩色球圈开口与白色打底袜的交织。

sentences.en: And by the 1960s, there were players like Frank Robinson of the Baltimore Orioles who were actually cutting the bottom part of the stirrup,
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪60年代，有些球员比如巴尔的摩金莺队的弗兰克·罗宾逊，他们实际上在剪掉球圈的底部，

sentences.en: the part that looped under your foot, and adding more fabric to it so that they could pull their stirrups even higher,
sentences.zh: 也就是绕在你脚下的部分，并给它添加更多面料，这样他们就可以把球圈拉得更高，

sentences.en: higher than the manufacturer had intended.
sentences.zh: 比制造商原本的设计拉得更高。

sentences.en: While stirrups may have had this functional origin, they quickly lost that.
sentences.zh: 虽然球圈可能有这样的功能性起源，但它们很快就失去了这个功能。

sentences.en: And they just became incorporated into the visual language of baseball.
sentences.zh: 它们只是融入了棒球的视觉语言中。

sentences.en: And I think for many people, myself included, it's what we think of when we think of a baseball player.
sentences.zh: 我想对很多人来说，包括我自己，当我们想到棒球运动员时，脑海中浮现的就是这个。

sentences.en: It's interesting to note that in the pages of The New Yorker, the weekly magazine,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在周刊《纽约客》的版面上，

sentences.en: they run a lot of cartoons that are baseball-themed.
sentences.zh: 他们刊登了许多以棒球为主题的漫画。

sentences.en: And their cartoonists almost invariably depict baseball players wearing stirrups,
sentences.zh: 他们的漫画家几乎无一例外地描绘穿着球圈的棒球运动员，

sentences.en: even though most actual baseball players today do not wear stirrups.
sentences.zh: 尽管今天大多数真正的棒球运动员并不穿球圈。

sentences.en: I played in a kid's baseball league, and I remember how official-seeming and functional stirrups seem to be,
sentences.zh: 我在一个儿童棒球联赛打过球，我记得球圈看起来是多么具有官方色彩和功能性，

sentences.en: despite the fact that, you know, with contemporary SOC technology, they are rendered essentially functionless.
sentences.zh: 尽管你知道，随着现代袜子技术的发展，它们实际上已经失去了功能。

sentences.en: But it seems that the romance is gone by the time you get to the big leagues.
sentences.zh: 但当你进入大联盟时，那种浪漫似乎已经消失了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and in fact, I've asked players, why do you wear your pants down?
sentences.zh: 是的，事实上，我问过球员，你为什么把裤子放下来？

sentences.en: And the answer I often get is, it's just so much less work.
sentences.zh: 我经常得到的回答是，这样省事多了。

sentences.en: You know, if you leave your pants down to your shoe tops, you don't, it's lower maintenance, essentially.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你把裤子垂到鞋口，你就不用，本质上维护成本更低。

sentences.en: You don't have to worry about your socks staying up.
sentences.zh: 你不必担心你的袜子会不会滑下来。

sentences.en: You don't have to worry that your stirrups are both sort of at the exact same height or level.
sentences.zh: 你不必担心你的两个球圈是否保持在完全相同的高度或水平。

sentences.en: You don't have to keep looking and checking to make sure that they're just so.
sentences.zh: 你不用一直盯着并检查它们是否恰到好处。

sentences.en: Just like most of us don't when we walk around with, you know, slacks or jeans or whatever with regular pants.
sentences.zh: 就像我们大多数人穿着西裤、牛仔裤或随便什么常规裤子走动时不会去注意的那样。

sentences.en: If you wear your pants low, you don't really have to worry about what's going on underneath them.
sentences.zh: 如果你把裤子穿得很低，你真的不需要担心裤子下面发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so it's just easier.
sentences.zh: 所以这样更简单。

sentences.en: And I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我能理解这一点。

sentences.en: If there's a villain in the story of baseball hosiery, that role would be filled by George Hendrick.
sentences.zh: 如果棒球袜类历史里有一个反派，这个角色非乔治·亨德里克莫属。

sentences.en: Who played for the Cardinals and A's and some other teams in the 70s and 80s.
sentences.zh: 他在70和80年代为红雀队、运动家队和其他一些球队效力过。

sentences.en: He's now the first base coach of the Tampa Bay Rays.
sentences.zh: 他现在是坦帕湾光芒队的一垒教练。

sentences.en: He's the one that's most often credited or blamed as the most influential player in the move towards long pants.
sentences.zh: 他最常被归功于或归咎于推动长裤潮流的最具影响力的球员。

sentences.en: And he liked to wear his pants down toward his ankles, which by today's standards is pretty tame.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢把裤子穿到接近脚踝的地方，按今天的标准来看这相当温和。

sentences.en: But by the standards of the era he played in was seen as radical.
sentences.zh: 但以他效力那个时代的标准来看，这被视为激进。

sentences.en: He showed very, very little of his socks or stirrups.
sentences.zh: 他露出的袜子或球圈非常非常少。

sentences.en: And some people thought it looked weird or it looked dumpy or it didn't look dignified or whatever.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这看起来很奇怪，或者看起来邋遢，或者看起来不够庄重之类的。

sentences.en: But there were other players who thought it looked different and therefore innovative and therefore cool.
sentences.zh: 但也有其他球员认为这看起来与众不同，因此很有创新精神，也很酷。

sentences.en: What Major League Baseball players, sock style, do you most admire?
sentences.zh: 你最欣赏哪位美国职棒大联盟球员的袜子风格？

sentences.en: At this point, I mean, it's pretty slim pickings in terms of hosiery heroes nowadays because there aren't many players who wear stirrups to begin with.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，袜类英雄可以说是寥寥无几，因为本来就没有多少球员穿球圈。

sentences.en: And even fewer who wear stirrups the way I like to see them, like the style I like.
sentences.zh: 更不用说像我喜欢的那样穿球圈的人了，也就是我喜欢的风格。

sentences.en: The best, I would say, is a pitcher named Josh Outman, which is a great name for baseball, right?
sentences.zh: 我可以说，最好的是一个名叫乔什·奥特曼的投手，这名字对棒球来说太棒了，对吧？

sentences.en: Outman.
sentences.zh: 奥特曼（Outman，意为三振出局者）。

sentences.en: He's a pitcher.
sentences.zh: 他是个投手。

sentences.en: He gets the players out.
sentences.zh: 他让球员出局。

sentences.en: And he wears a real 1970s style of stirrups that I love.
sentences.zh: 他穿着我非常喜欢的真正的70年代风格球圈。

sentences.en: A lot of other people don't love it so much.
sentences.zh: 许多其他人并不是那么喜欢它。

sentences.en: But he's number one as far as I'm concerned.
sentences.zh: 但就我而言，他是第一名。

sentences.en: Reed Johnson, who's an outfielder.
sentences.zh: 里德·约翰逊，他是一名外野手。

sentences.en: He wears stirrups in a not-too-shabby way.
sentences.zh: 他穿球圈的风格还算不错。

sentences.en: But the fact that I have to search my mental database to come up with three or four players, it's just not that great in terms of stirrups.
sentences.zh: 但事实上我必须在脑海的数据库里搜索才能找出三四个球员，从球圈的角度来看这实在不怎么样。

sentences.en: Now, there are other players who do hike their pants up high and just wear solid color socks and do so pretty nicely.
sentences.zh: 现在，还有其他球员确实把裤子拉得很高，只穿纯色袜子，而且穿得相当不错。

sentences.en: Curtis Granderson, man, he looks great in a uniform.
sentences.zh: 柯蒂斯·格兰德森，天哪，他穿制服看起来棒极了。

sentences.en: Steven Strasburg of the Washington Nationals, the young phenom pitcher, does something great called blousing,
sentences.zh: 华盛顿国民队的史蒂芬·斯特拉斯堡，这位年轻的超级新星投手，做了一件很棒的事情，叫做“卷裤脚”（blousing），

sentences.en: which means he doesn't just hike his pants up, but he tucks under the cuff in a way where it just sort of blouses out a little bit at the point where he tucks it under,
sentences.zh: 这意味着他不仅把裤子拉高，而且把裤脚往里塞，使其在他塞进去的地方稍微向外鼓起一点，

sentences.en: instead of just bunching them up the way Alex Rodriguez does, for example.
sentences.zh: 而不是像亚历克斯·罗德里格斯那样把它们挤成一团。

sentences.en: And that's sort of a lost art blousing.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种失传的艺术——卷裤脚。

sentences.en: Jim Tomei, who recently retired, slugger, who played for many teams, great, great blouser.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·托米，最近退役的强力打者，曾效力于多支球队，绝对是个卷裤脚高手。

sentences.en: All-time blouser.
sentences.zh: 史上最强卷裤脚高手。

sentences.en: So, there are lots of little elements here to appreciate.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有很多小元素值得欣赏。

sentences.en: There is absolutely no doubt that the final cut of this piece includes you saying,
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这段节目的最终剪辑版里包括你说：

sentences.en: Jim Tomei, former slugger for the Cleveland Indians, great blouser.
sentences.zh: “吉姆·托米，前克利夫兰印第安人队强力打者，卷裤脚高手。”

sentences.en: Excellent, excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，太棒了。

sentences.en: All-time great blouser.
sentences.zh: 史上最强卷裤脚高手。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Jesse Thorne,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由杰西·索恩制作，

sentences.en: with Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffleman, Katie Mingle, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 合作者有萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特拉弗尔曼、凯蒂·明格，还有我，罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: Jesse Thorne is the host of the NPR program Bullseye,
sentences.zh: 杰西·索恩是NPR节目《靶心》的主持人，

sentences.en: the best pop culture interview program around today, full stop.
sentences.zh: 这是当今最好的流行文化访谈节目，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: It is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 它太棒了。

sentences.en: If you want to learn about the good stuff in popular culture,
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解流行文化中的好东西，

sentences.en: TV, movies, books, music, video games, this is essential listening.
sentences.zh: 电视、电影、书籍、音乐、电子游戏，这是必听节目。

sentences.en: Subscribe to Bullseye in iTunes or go to MaximumFun.org.
sentences.zh: 在iTunes上订阅《靶心》或访问MaximumFun.org。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7地方公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 由ArcSign办公室制作，

sentences.en: a group of architects who would never dishonor architecture's hosiery heritage.
sentences.zh: 这是一个绝不会玷污建筑学袜类传统的建筑师团体。

sentences.en: We have more stories about design all the time on Facebook, Twitter, and Tumblr,
sentences.zh: 我们在Facebook、Twitter和Tumblr上随时分享更多关于设计的故事，

sentences.en: but we keep our pants rolled to our knees and our stirrups straight at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 但在99pi.org，我们始终把裤子卷到膝盖，把球圈拉得笔直。
